verdict.rationale: Firstbase documents a compliance dashboard showing company status per state, with requirements, deadlines, and new-state expansion. It also offers in-app mail scanning, file digitization, and unlimited digital storage for received documents, all pitched as 'everything in one place.' However, nothing shows managing multiple entities under one account or giving a team shared access. Missing for 10: evidence of multi-entity management from a single account, team or multi-user access with roles, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the dashboard and document inbox.
